notes: Full description: pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs ValidityMaxLint::check_cert() at line 112: fn check_cert(&self, cert: &Certificate, _kind: SubjectKind, _now_unix: u64) — the _now_unix parameter is named with underscore prefix (correctly indicating it is intentionally unused), and the lint uses cert.tbs_certificate.validity.not_before as the issuance time instead. The doc comment at lines 83-88 explains this is correct per SC-081: 'The cap phase is evaluated at the certificate's notBefore (issuance time), not at the relying party's current time.' This is intentional and correct. However, the test at cabf_tls_br_tests.rs:96-108 (validity_max_pass_pre_sc081_evaluated_late) correctly tests that now_unix does NOT affect the result. This finding is actually NOT a bug. The code is correct and intentional. Close as P4/opinion.
title: FINDING (P4/not-a-bug): ValidityMaxLint ignores now_unix intentionally per SC-081
